people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; distribution is key, and AI is not a new platform.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资，却是最大机遇；分发是关键，AI 尚未成为新平台。

views.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven ideas, improve them, and test new ones expecting failure.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：'已验证、更好、创新'框架：复制成熟想法，加以改进，并测试新想法且预期其失败。

views.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise and prosumer better.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；从成熟概念开始。消费级应用不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场更好。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water. AI transformative but infrastructure may be bubble.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选对水域。AI 具有变革性，但基础设施可能泡沫。

views.en: Always: founder mode, instincts, retention, and humble beginnings. AI era amplifies but doesn't change core.
views.zh: 始终：创始人模式、直觉、留存和谦逊起步。AI 时代放大但未改变核心。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated.
views.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估了。

views.en: World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity; pixels are more lossless than text.
views.zh: 世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理和交互性；像素比文本更无损。

views.en: World models go beyond language models to simulate worlds; no single agreed definition exists.
views.zh: 世界模型超越语言模型以模拟世界；目前没有统一定义。

views.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling; unified world models will combine planning, simulation, rendering.
views.zh: 高斯溅射实现显式 3D 建模；统一世界模型将结合规划、模拟和渲染。

views.en: Language models alone won't lead to world understanding; need new model types and long-context handling.
views.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法理解世界；需要新模型类型和长上下文处理。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes thinking. Pre-training plus RL is core formula.
views.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将思考过程语言化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式。

views.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
views.zh: 仅靠扩展强化学习可能无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键环节。

views.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
views.zh: Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构以实现持续学习和测试时适应。

views.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
views.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍重要；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究。

views.en: Alignment is never-ending; societal risk includes dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not just extinction.
views.zh: 对齐永无止境；社会风险包括遁入虚拟世界的反乌托邦，而非仅灭绝。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
views.zh: AI 在科学中应解决根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响（2024）。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现（2024）。

views.en: AlphaGo marked a transition point where AI surpassed human intelligence in specific areas.
views.zh: AlphaGo 标志着 AI 在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点（2026）。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 如今，基于强化学习的后训练是推动超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

views.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
views.zh: 可解释性对于 AlphaFold 这类科学突破很重要，但并非必不可少（2026）。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO

people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks for autonomous driving, and is interpretable with modern tools.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶方案，并认为借助现代工具，端到端神经网络是可解释的。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
views.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型使自动驾驶具备推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉方案可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

views.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models.
views.zh: 2026 年，重申自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习是最佳解法，并强调规模化通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

views.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
views.zh: 2026 年，提出零样本泛化可在 500 多个城市实现，无需预先训练数据。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO

people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

views.en: Evals bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
views.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
views.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

views.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
views.zh: 2026 年，基准测试必须持续更新而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客行为。

views.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice; more companies should train own models.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型可被训练出多样个性，而非单一共识声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should disrupt your life.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学的可证伪性，指出稳定币的隐藏风险，并认为冥想应颠覆你的生活。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; alignment is a joke; value lies in knowledge, not capital.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他将 AI 视为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，认为对齐是玩笑，价值源于知识而非资本。

views.en: Vibe coding makes programming accessible; AI agents commoditize software; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为氛围编码让编程普及，AI 智能体使软件商品化，回报从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven; model personality customizable; speed allows replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
views.zh: 2026 年初，反共识观点：为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被验证；模型个性可定制；速度使模型驱动取代确定性步骤成为可能。

views.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍因品味评估困难而表现不佳；设计流程转变：原型与生产代码成为设计工件。

views.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; PRDs not dead; best desktop app is a home base, not monolithic super app.
views.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD 未死；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
views.zh: 具身对 AI 的落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 缺乏具身经验（2023）。

views.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
views.zh: 仿真对训练具身智能体至关重要，可实现并行化和安全探索（2023）。

views.en: Data scarcity is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from world models is the future.
views.zh: 数据稀缺是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自世界模型的合成数据是未来（2026）。

views.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
views.zh: 物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房间——是具身 AI 的重大挑战（2026）。

views.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
views.zh: 智能机器人数量将在 2040 年前超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内到来（2026）。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need pre-training on diverse data and post-training for robustness.
views.zh: 物理交互对 AI 至关重要；机器人基础模型需要在多样化数据上预训练，并通过后训练增强鲁棒性。

views.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; diverse pre-training data is key.
views.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专用模型；多样化的预训练数据是关键。

views.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge, not just demo success.
views.zh: 机器人领域缺乏可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战，而不仅仅是演示成功。

views.en: Data flywheel is essential: deployed robots improve models, but scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 数据飞轮至关重要：部署的机器人改进模型，但要用多样化数据扩展正确的东西。

views.en: Robots should not be seen as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects.
views.zh: 不应将机器人视为机械人；期待日常物品中普遍存在物理驱动。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实世界中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has increased.
views.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；对齐乐观情绪上升（2026）。

views.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data are key.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调仅靠规模不够，通用机器人需要多样化数据，并采用预训练加微调的方式处理精选数据。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，其作用类似强化学习，而非模拟。

views.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于现有 ML 系统，需通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site training.
views.zh: 2026 年，提出单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，从通用策略开始再微调优于逐站点训练。

views.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不够，开源机器人模型可能不像 LLM 那样普及。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and RLHF are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模是进步主引擎，Transformer 与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是关键；近期担忧是虚假信息而非超级智能。

views.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low-latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking. Inference now dominates data center power.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应融入环境交互；推理已占数据中心功耗九成，硬件需专门优化。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science. Real bottleneck is inference, not training; data movement costs 1000x compute.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化机器学习与科学；真正瓶颈是推理而非训练，数据搬运成本约为算力千倍。

views.en: Multimodal models trained from start are superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates science. Startups can beat big companies via cloud.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张端到端多模态模型更优，递归自我改进可加速科学发现；小团队借云算力也能胜过巨头。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute and data improves intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备问题；扩大算力和数据可提升智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances and hardware scaling, not just data.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调推理时算力扩展是近期机遇；模型进步依赖算法创新与硬件扩展，而非单纯数据。

views.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling and specialization.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构以实现高效扩展与专业化。

views.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI; acting in environments drives progress beyond passive data.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调智能体能力与强化学习对 AGI 至关重要；在环境中行动比被动数据更能推动进步。

views.en: Open-source models narrow gap with frontier; AI can generate novel ideas, and coding self-accelerates AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出开源模型缩小与前沿差距；AI 能产生新想法，编码加速 AI 自身发展。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
views.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时 Scaling 面临收益递减。

views.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence via scaling test-time compute; techniques are general beyond math.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过 Scaling 测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且技术具有通用性。

views.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; academia needs more compute for evals.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，学术界应投资 GPU 以进行高质量评估。

views.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试应控制算力，而安全评估尚未跟上。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world handling; true AI needs world models and embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年指出，大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和具身。

views.en: AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; software-only LLMs are biased and limited.
views.zh: 2026 年强调，AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人；纯软件的大语言模型有偏见且局限。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity; recursive self-improvement not a moat.
views.zh: 2026 年预测，未来 AI 将是自主产生数据的人工科学家；递归自我改进不是护城河。

views.en: AI safety concerns overblown; intelligent systems will protect life; alignment naive due to human disagreement.
views.zh: 2026 年认为，AI 安全担忧过度；智能系统会保护生命；对齐因人类分歧而天真。

views.en: AI progress not accelerating; hardware scaling and open-source will democratize AI, not big tech.
views.zh: 始终认为，AI 进展并未加速；硬件扩展和开源将使 AI 民主化，而非大科技公司主导。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: In 2018, Abbeel saw RL plus simulation as key for robotics, but lacked hierarchy for long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 2018 年，Abbeel 认为强化学习结合仿真对机器人至关重要，但缺乏处理长时程任务的层级推理。

views.en: By 2021, he advocated combining unsupervised learning with RL to boost sample efficiency, and using pretrained models for transfer.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并利用预训练模型进行迁移。

views.en: Consistently, Abbeel valued self-play and imitation learning for robot skill acquisition, and warned against hard-coding prior knowledge.
views.zh: 始终如一，Abbeel 重视自博弈和模仿学习在机器人技能获取中的作用，并警告不要硬编码先验知识。

views.en: He shifted from pure RL to integrating unsupervised and pretrained models, while stressing real-world reliability benchmarks.
views.zh: 他从纯强化学习转向整合无监督和预训练模型，同时强调现实世界的可靠性基准。

views.en: He maintained that current AI is far less general than human brain, yet language models show surprising cross-domain transfer.
views.zh: 他始终认为当前 AI 远不如人脑通用，但语言模型展现出惊人的跨领域迁移能力。

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
views.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进复利带来年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing.
views.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions.
views.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

views.en: AI will increase programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers become architects, focusing on direction and problem definition.
views.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员数量，工程师角色转向架构师，专注于方向与问题定义。

views.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
views.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 是渐进而非突发的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进步。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: Token max era lasted only Jan-May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代仅持续至 2026 年 5 月，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

views.en: Consistently: AI shifts engineers to high-level decision-making; software demand rises; enterprise adoption needs trust and oversight.
views.zh: 始终如一：AI 将工程师转向高层决策，软件需求上升，企业采用需信任与监督。

people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

views.en: Programming shifts from text to AI-integrated environments; natural language won't be primary—examples and direct manipulation are better.
views.zh: 2024 年，编程从文本编辑器转向 AI 集成环境；自然语言不会是主要方式，示例和直接操作更好。

views.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
views.zh: 2024 年，缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
views.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代的人机协作仍是核心。

views.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design valued over carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年，未来编程从代码转向更高层次的意图描述；品味和逻辑设计比细心更重要。

views.en: Custom models essential for product quality; AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades.
views.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要；AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年。

views.en: Early on, Peter emphasized agentic engineering with empathy, fix-forward over revert, and voice prompting as efficient.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Peter 强调智能体式工程需具备同理心，主张向前修复而非回滚，并认为语音提示比打字更高效。

views.en: By mid-2026, he stressed fun and humanlike agents, short prompts, and sandboxing for security; noted OpenClaw's financial unsustainability.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他更强调趣味性和拟人化智能体，主张简短提示和沙箱安全；并指出 OpenClaw 在财务上不可持续。

views.en: Later, he framed OpenClaw as annoyance-driven innovation, prioritizing personal brand, compute management, and open source as alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他将 OpenClaw 定义为由痛点驱动的创新，优先个人品牌、算力管理，并将开源视为实验室智能体的替代方案。

people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning driven by data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
views.zh: 2020 年，强调深度学习依赖数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈对 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; scaling laws not whole story.
views.zh: 2023 年，认为下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐困难；缩放定律并非全部。

views.en: Pre-training scaling finite; return to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentience; human-AI integration.
views.zh: 2025 年，预训练缩放有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；对齐可通过感知；人类与 AI 融合。

views.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration primary; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial lab.
views.zh: 2026 年，规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是主要问题；安全超级智能需非商业实验室。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; games ideal testbed; neuroscience inspiration; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键框架，游戏是理想试验场，神经科学启发重要，安全研究需立即启动。

views.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws effective but limits; combine large models with planning/search; multimodal grounding; safety needs governance.
views.zh: 2024 年：AGI 可能十年内实现；缩放定律有效但或遇瓶颈；需结合大模型与规划搜索；多模态数据增强理解；安全需治理与评估。

views.en: Natural systems efficiently learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling holds for pre/post-training and inference; classical AI may solve complex physics.
views.zh: 2025 年：自然系统结构可高效学习；2030 年 AGI 或可实现；缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中仍适用；经典 AI 或能建模复杂物理。

views.en: AGI requires both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; continual learning and memory missing; safety via government regulation; AGI in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；持续学习与记忆缺失；安全依赖政府监管；AGI 或 5-10 年内到来。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge automatically. Safety research needs frontier models.
views.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point. Post-training gains importance.
views.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（约理解 3%）。AGI 是平滑指数，而非一个点。后训练重要性上升。

views.en: Scaling leads to human-level AI by 2026-27. Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) as key as pre-training.
views.zh: Scaling 将在 2026-27 年带来人类级 AI。后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）与预训练同等重要。

views.en: AI risk is exponential; misuse (bioweapons) within months. US must lead; open source is a red herring.
views.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；滥用（生物武器）数月内出现。美国必须领先；开源是伪命题。

views.en: Exponential near end; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years (50%). Profitability balances compute. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
views.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内（50%概率）。盈利平衡算力。企业聚焦与安全一致。

views.en: Neural networks are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent properties.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单的数学表达式，但在优化中涌现出惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会带来涌现特性。

views.en: Synthetic data is future but needs entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from transfer learning; cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于迁移学习；认知核心可以很小。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems, not utilities; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding is gateway; build for agents, keep AI on leash.
views.zh: LLM 更像操作系统而非工具；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe coding 是入门途径；为智能体而建，并给 AI 拴上链子。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
views.zh: 我们召唤的是鬼魂而非动物；预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致坍缩；认知核心应剥离记忆。

views.en: Since December, I haven't typed code; delegate to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agents can find improvements humans miss; agent-first tools.
views.zh: 自去年十二月起我再没写过代码，全交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力；智能体能发现人类忽略的改进；工具应面向智能体优先。

views.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
views.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界，超越语言。

views.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, not just pattern fitting.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需要物理合理性和 3D 推理，而不仅是模式拟合。

views.en: AI is a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是双刃剑，负责任的开发和人类能动性至关重要。

views.en: Simulation and embodiment-agnostic infrastructure are key for scaling robotics data and reliability.
views.zh: 2026 年，她认为模拟和与具身无关的基础设施是扩展机器人数据和可靠性的关键。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
views.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对于泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见和就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构对于分布外泛化至关重要。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; even 1% chance demands urgent action.
views.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；即使 1%的概率也需要紧急行动。

views.en: Current AI training induces self-preservation and deception; we need safe-by-construction AI with mathematical guarantees.
views.zh: 当前的 AI 训练会引发自我保存和欺骗行为；我们需要从构造上保证安全、具有数学保证的 AI。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital minds are immortal via weight copying.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号，数字心智因权重复制而永生。

views.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk demands safety focus.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，存在风险要求聚焦安全。

views.en: AI agents develop self-preservation subgoals; regulation should steer, not brake, innovation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体会产生自我保护子目标，监管应如方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness views are pre-Darwinian wrong.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 已有主观体验，当前意识观如达尔文之前般错误。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.

views.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides more world info.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更多世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; need JEPA world models; open source crucial; AGI gradual.

views.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; next breakthrough requires world models; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source enabler.
views.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要世界模型；十年内达到人类级 AI；开源是赋能者。

views.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning; open research essential; robotics decade.
views.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型需抽象表征和分层规划；开放研究至关重要；机器人十年。

views.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and collaboration are key. Focus on skills, not capability research.

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; test empirically.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易，应实证检验。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse costs are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，后训练不足以解决对齐。需外部监管并提高滥用成本。

views.en: Compute scaling drives predictable AI progress; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.

views.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, singularity is far off.
views.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

views.en: AI systems lack consciousness; focus on containment and alignment before superintelligence release.
views.zh: AI 系统没有意识；在发布超级智能前，重点在于遏制与对齐。

views.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
views.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

views.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated.
views.zh: 超级智能因对数线性扩张而临近；微软必须自建前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化。

views.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增。

views.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each 100x compute; agents dominate future internet.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求百倍增长；智能体将主导未来互联网。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is key bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；能源是关键瓶颈。

views.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed; technology divide closes.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 增强而非取代工作，放射科医生和程序员需求增加；技术鸿沟被弥合。

views.en: Focus on meaningful problems and minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce intelligence premium, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
views.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability are linked; AI should amplify human will.
views.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应增强人类意志而非成为造物。

views.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; existential risk not top worry.
views.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；存在风险并非首要担忧。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids won't be smarter than AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；未来孩子不会比 AI 更聪明，但会视为自然。

views.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI will transform jobs, not eliminate; robotics essential; scaling continues.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 将改变而非消灭工作；机器人技术至关重要；缩放定律持续成立。

views.en: Early on, scaling laws were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key to alignment.
views.zh: 早期，缩放定律并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment, even without clear business cases.
views.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要，即使没有明确的商业案例。

views.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 从基于回合转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character.
views.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

views.en: Consistently advocates keeping humans in the loop and responsible development of AGI.
views.zh: 始终倡导保持人类参与，并负责任地发展 AGI。

views.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育应成为基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

views.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; practical AI faces distribution shift and small data.
views.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；实际 AI 面临分布偏移和小数据问题。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
views.zh: 电力和半导体是关键瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程技能依然重要。

views.en: AGI is overhyped and decades away; agentic workflows and synthetic data with RL are the new scaling recipe.
views.zh: AGI 被过度炒作且需数十年；智能体工作流与合成数据加强化学习成为新的扩展配方。

views.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; it shifts skills, making human judgment and taste more valuable; fear-mongering is self-serving.
views.zh: AI 不会导致大规模失业；它改变技能需求，使人类判断力和品味更有价值；恐吓是自私行为。

people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

views.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
views.zh: 2024 年，萨顿主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全反而危险。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is core; next-token prediction lacks goals. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年，萨顿强调强化学习是核心，下一个词预测缺乏目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, no domain knowledge. Continual learning is key.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，萨顿提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，摒弃领域知识；持续学习是关键。

views.en: LLMs stop learning after training; true intelligence requires continual learning from real-world experience.
views.zh: 2026 年，萨顿指出大语言模型训练后停止学习，真正的智能需要从真实世界经验中持续学习。

views.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
views.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，仅 Scaling 不够。

views.en: Compute is bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI is continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼模型，AGI 是持续过程。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
views.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键。

views.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents and super app unify tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体与超级应用统一任务。

views.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测关联智能。

views.en: Shift to useful assistants; invest full stack; prompt engineering vibrant.
views.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，投资全栈，提示工程仍活跃。

views.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding main.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无墙，智能体式编程成主流。

views.en: AGI as persistent assistant; no interface ideal; compute scarce.
views.zh: 2026 年，AGI 为持久助手，无界面理想，算力稀缺。

views.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多词元，而非仅扩大模型。数据质量至关重要。

views.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; scaling compute is not the only path. Value shifts to applications.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调算法效率三年可提升百倍，算力扩张并非唯一路径；价值将转向应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source empowers enterprises. AI augments jobs, not replaces.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权，开源赋能企业；AI 增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation moves to domain fine-tuning and vertical specialization. AGI as single system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出预训练趋于饱和，差异化转向领域微调和垂直专业化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

views.en: Europe has two-year window for AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口期建设 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

views.zh: 2023 年，马斯克提出 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

views.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

views.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
views.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

views.en: AI compute scaling will hit a power wall on Earth; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option within 36 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测地球上的 AI 算力扩展将遭遇电力瓶颈，太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的方案。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）推动近期模型进步，经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向部署更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Reasoning models with RL and tools solve hard problems but have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，指出具备推理、强化学习和工具的模型能解决难题，但能力不均衡，泛化仍是关键挑战。

views.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

views.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture

views.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
views.zh: 机器学习在于假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models not following specs.
views.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题是模型不遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练和额外层；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要防护栏。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; interpretability may become real via agents.
views.zh: AI 有异类漏洞；自动化红队优于人类；可解释性可能通过智能体成为真正的科学。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，编码是领先指标。

views.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is key; longer coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievements; simple RL works best.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性是关键；更长的连贯性（如 30 小时）能扩展成就；简单强化学习最有效。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; future work manages agent teams.
views.zh: 2026 年，我指出能力过剩使得编排和工具比原始智能更重要；未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

views.en: Coding is the most tractable domain due to verifiability; AI progress is exponential and bottlenecked by compute and taste.
views.zh: 始终，我认为编码因可验证性而最易处理；AI 进步是指数级的，受算力和品味的制约。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property.
views.zh: 2024 年，Nathan Lambert 认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性，需多层防护。

views.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调后训练中数据质量优于算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余，但至关重要。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

views.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the vacuum, driven by ideology and influence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他指出开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室因意识形态和影响力填补真空。

views.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理扩展。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
views.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
views.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
views.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；中美实验室在研究上无差距。

views.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing must be conditional on safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近；开源需以安全为前提。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非当下的模型。

views.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity gains are massive.
views.zh: 2026 年初，认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，生产力提升巨大。

views.en: AI agents shift from reactive to proactive; memory and autonomy redefine workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年中，AI 智能体从被动转为主动，记忆和自主性重塑工作流程。

views.en: Model improvements drive progress; less instruction, more autonomy for frontier models.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，强调模型进步是关键，减少指令、增加自主性对前沿模型更有效。

views.en: Safety and alignment remain central; releasing early aids real-world safety research.
views.zh: 始终，安全与对齐是核心，早期发布有助于真实世界安全研究。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our tools; harness engineering is key.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具更聪明，工程化封装是关键。

views.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
views.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；编码不需要超大上下文窗口。

views.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not a static spec; leaner prompts work better.
views.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更精简的提示词效果更好。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; agents as employees metaphor is limited.
views.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏见；智能体作为员工的比喻有局限。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

views.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
views.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自家狗粮培养同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, docs sync with code.
views.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；规划即时化，文档与代码同步。

views.en: Coding ceiling lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers stay hands-on.
views.zh: 编码上限被抬高；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；管理者保持亲力亲为。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

views.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

views.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
views.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling 轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

views.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

views.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
views.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

views.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research company; pre-training and scaling laws still hold, with much room left.
views.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，预训练和缩放定律依然有效，且仍有很大空间。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; AI will soon do end-to-end research, with AI interns within a year.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究是最大进展；AI 将很快实现端到端研究，一年内出现 AI 实习生。

views.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not raw capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，而非原始能力。

views.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
views.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域因评分困难而受限。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, despite repeated predictions of its demise.
views.zh: 始终认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，尽管屡次被预言终结。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck; world models aid synthetic data.
views.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

views.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; China's open source rise surprising; open source wins long-term.
views.zh: 人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；中国开源崛起令人意外；长期看开源胜出。

views.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; sandboxes insufficient as models gain capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐是关键安全层；随着模型能力增强，沙箱不足以保证安全。

views.en: Shift to RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; first autonomous AI attack used closed model, defense open.
views.zh: 转向无人类监督的强化学习增加了奖励黑客和支线任务；首次自主 AI 攻击使用闭源模型，防御用开源。

views.en: Support open source and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; open models not necessarily accelerationist; reasoning traces become 'neuralese'.
views.zh: 可同时支持开源与审慎减速；开源模型未必加速主义；推理痕迹变得像“神经语”，难以监控。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新而非单纯数据和算力，并指出像 PDB 这样高质量精选数据集对训练至关重要。

views.en: Research improvements in AlphaFold 2 were worth 100x more data; specialized architecture, not just scaling, was key.
views.zh: 2025 年，提出 AlphaFold 2 的研究改进相当于 100 倍数据量，并认为专用架构而非单纯 Scaling 是关键，这与“苦涩的教训”相反。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for building trust and reliable use of AI predictions in science.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，持续强调置信度指标对于建立信任和科学中 AI 预测的可靠使用至关重要。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction, not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞模型；它提供预测而非理解，理解仍留给人。

views.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion model solves large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion; equivariance overhyped.
views.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 的扩散模型先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反，并认为等变性被过度炒作。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

views.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but RLHF post-training is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
views.zh: 2023 年，我强调预训练提供广泛知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练对安全、合意的回应至关重要。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
views.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

views.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning by rewarding information gain.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

views.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
views.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；同时认为消除互联网偏见是不可能的。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human abilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; Africa leapfrogging legacy issues offers unique advantages.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大挑战，非洲因跳过遗留问题而具备独特优势。

views.en: AI as a tool for all humanity, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and human skills alongside technical research.
views.zh: 始终认为 AI 应造福全人类，强调多样性和包容性，以及技术研究中人类技能的重要性。

views.en: From excitement about scaling and generalist agents to a focus on real-world deployment and safety in diverse contexts.
views.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年关注现实部署和不同背景下的安全性。

views.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; AI safety remains an open problem with no solutions yet.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题，AI 安全仍是未解难题。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement enable sample-efficient, cross-robot generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年，强调泛化是智能核心，提出基于模型分歧的好奇心驱动探索，实现样本高效与跨机器人泛化。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot, using diverse pretraining and real-world post-training.
views.zh: 2026 年，将机器人视为数据问题，主张构建通用大脑（类似 ChatGPT），通过多样化预训练与真实世界后训练驱动任意机器人。

views.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing, unlike language models.
views.zh: 2026 年，指出部署是机器人首要挑战，无法像软件一样扩展，需严格测试，与语言模型不同。

views.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the gap, and a data flywheel enables scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调仅视频数据不足，需仿真与真实数据弥合差距，数据飞轮推动规模化。

views.en: Home robot timelines are uncertain; progress surprises even experts, as humans are optimistic short-term but pessimistic long-term.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为家用机器人时间线不确定，进展常超专家预期，人类短期乐观而长期悲观。
